Container.Name: ROMarrNG-Browser
Container.Overview: Alternative ROMarrNG image with the Playwright client for browser-based downloads. Requires a separate, version-matched Playwright browser server. Use instead of the standard ROMarrNG container.
Container.Description: ROMarrNG Browser is the Debian image variant for the optional Headless Browser download client. It contains the Playwright Python client but no Chromium. Run a separate Playwright server and set Browser Host in Download Clients. This template shares the standard template's appdata and web port; do not run both containers at once.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: romarrng romarr browser playwright rom emulation game seerrng
Container.Changes: Debian image variant with the matching Playwright client. Chromium runs in a separate browser server; direct download support is unchanged.
Container.Requires: Docker, persistent appdata, and a separate Playwright server for Headless Browser downloads.
